## Method:

**5) Completely random, but the passengers enter in waves** For example, Southwest's open seating system (I don't think they do this anymore) with Groups A, B, and C

## Planning:

**5) Completely random, but the passengers enter in waves** The 72 passengers are randomly split into three groups of 24 called A, B, and C. Group A passengers board first, and each Group A passenger takes a random, unoccupied seat anywhere in the plane. Groups B and C follow, but each subsequent group has fewer seats to choose from.

## Coding

### Setting Up

```{r}
library(pbapply)
library(tidyverse)
set.seed(67)

```

### Preparing for the Boarding

```{r}
# Determine the order in which the passengers enter the plane
  order_group <- function(full_df, group_num) {
    group_df <- full_df %>% filter(group == group_num)
    shuffled_idx <- sample(nrow(group_df))
    group_order_df <- data.frame(
      id = group_df$id[shuffled_idx], 
      target_row = group_df$target_row[shuffled_idx], 
      overhead_time = group_df$overhead_time[shuffled_idx], 
      plane_mat_column = group_df$plane_mat_column[shuffled_idx]
    )
    return(group_order_df)
  }

# Set up where the passengers sit, what group they're in, how long they need at the overhead bins, etc.
prepare_func <- function(n_row, n_col, n_groups) {
  n_passengers <- n_row * n_col
  target_seats <- 1:n_passengers
  
  # Each passenger has an assigned group and a seat that they will randomly choose. Let's say that 87% of passengers use the overhead bin.
  passengers <- data.frame(
    id = sample(target_seats), 
    group = sample(rep(1:n_groups, length.out = n_passengers)), 
    target_seat = target_seats, 
    target_row = c(rep(1:n_row, n_col)), 
    overhead = rbinom(n = n_passengers, size = 1, prob = 0.87)
  )
  
  # Log-normal distribution is right-skewed
  # curve(dlnorm(x, log(2), 0.6), from = 0, to = 10)
  passengers$overhead_time <- ifelse(passengers$overhead == 1, ceiling(rlnorm(n = n_passengers, meanlog = log(2), sdlog = 0.6)), 0)
  
  passengers <- passengers %>%
    mutate(
      plane_mat_column = case_when(
        target_seat >= 1 & target_seat <= (n_row) ~ 1,
        target_seat > (n_row) & target_seat <= (n_row * 2) ~ 2,
        target_seat > (n_row * 2) & target_seat <= (n_row * 3) ~ 3,
        target_seat > (n_row * 3) & target_seat <= (n_row * 4) ~ 4,
        target_seat > (n_row * 4) & target_seat <= (n_row * 5) ~ 5,
        target_seat > (n_row * 5) & target_seat <= (n_row * 6) ~ 6
      )
    )
  
  # # Sanity check
  # plane_mat <- matrix(0, nrow = n_row, ncol = n_col, byrow = TRUE)
  # print(plane_mat)   # The plane at the start of the simulation
  # 
  # target_mat <- plane_mat + passengers$id
  # print(target_mat)   # The positions of all the passengers after they have boarded
  
  group_a_order <- order_group(passengers, 1)
  group_b_order <- order_group(passengers, 2)
  group_c_order <- order_group(passengers, 3)
  return(list(group_a_order, group_b_order, group_c_order, n_row, n_col))
}

```

### The Simulation Function

```{r}
# The gamma distribution is right-skewed and can model waiting times
passenger_shuffle_time <- function(n_block) {
  if (n_block == 0) {
    return(0)
  } else {
    return(ceiling(sum(rgamma(n = n_block, shape = 3, rate = 3/5))))
  }
}

# Function for boarding a group
board_group <- function(group_order_df, plane_mat, time, n_row) {

  # Initializations
  next_person <- 1
  in_aisle = rep(0, length.out = n_row)
  wait = rep(-1, n_row)
  
  while (next_person <= nrow(group_order_df) || any(in_aisle > 0)) {
    time <- time + 1     # Increment the elapsed time
  
    for (i in which(in_aisle > 0)) {     # Loop through the rows of the plane, but only the ones in which there is a person in the aisle
      
      current_person_id <- in_aisle[i]                                                        # Get their id
      target_row <- group_order_df$target_row[group_order_df$id == current_person_id]         # Get their target row
      target_col <- group_order_df$plane_mat_column[group_order_df$id == current_person_id]   # Get the column of their target seat
    
      if (i == target_row) {   # If row i is that person's target row
        
        if (wait[i] < 0) {     # If that person just arrived at their target row for the first time
          overhead_time <- group_order_df$overhead_time[group_order_df$id == current_person_id]     # Get the time that they need at the overhead bin
          
          # Figure out how many people are between them and their seat
          if (target_col == 1) {                      # If they're in a left window seat
            n_block <- sum(plane_mat[i, 2:3] > 0)         # Find out if the left middle and left aisle seats are occupied
          } else if (target_col == 2) {               # If they're in a left middle seat
            n_block <- sum(plane_mat[i, 3] > 0)           # Find out if the left aisle seat is occupied
          } else if (target_col == 5) {               # If they're in a right middle seat
            n_block <- sum(plane_mat[i, 4] > 0)           # Find out if the right aisle seat is occupied
          } else if (target_col == 6) {               # If they're in a right window seat
            n_block <- sum(plane_mat[i, 4:5] > 0)         # Find out if the right middle and right aisle seats are occupied
          } else {                                    # They're in an aisle seat, and this issue doesn't apply to them
            n_block <- 0
          }
          
          shuffle_time <- passenger_shuffle_time(n_block)   # Get the time they'll spend getting around people who block their seat
          wait[i] <- overhead_time + shuffle_time           # Assign the total time units that they'll spend blocking the aisle
        }
        
        if (wait[i] == 0) {     # If that person is no longer blocking the aisle of their target row
          plane_mat[i, target_col] <- current_person_id     # Add that person to the plane matrix to indicate that they're fully seated
          in_aisle[i] <- 0   # Remove that person from the aisle
          wait[i] <- -1      # Reset the wait timer for this row because the person in this row is now fully seated
        
        } else {
          wait[i] <- wait[i] - 1     # If that person is not done in the aisle yet, decrease their wait timer by 1
        }
      }
    }
    
    # Loop through the back of the plane to the front, but skip the furthest back row (you can't advance if you're in the farthest back row)
    for (i in (n_row - 1):1) {
      
      # If the current aisle cell has a person in it
      # And if this cell does not have a person who is getting seated in their target row and blocking the aisle
      # And if the cell ahead does not have a person in it
      if (in_aisle[i] > 0 && wait[i] < 0 && in_aisle[i + 1] == 0) {
        in_aisle[i + 1] <- in_aisle[i]   # Move the current person ahead in the aisle by 1 row
        in_aisle[i] <- 0                 # Remove them from their current position
      }
    }
  
    # If there is still someone yet to enter the plane aisle and the aisle in the first row has a space
    if (next_person <= nrow(group_order_df) && in_aisle[1] == 0) {
      in_aisle[1] <- group_order_df$id[next_person]   # Assign that person to the first position of the aisle, letting them enter the plane
      next_person <- next_person + 1                  # Indicate that one more person has entered the plane
    }
  }
  return(list(plane_mat, time))
}

```

### Getting the Results (of one simulation)

```{r}
run_one_sim <- function() {
  prepare_func_output <- prepare_func(
    n_row = 12, 
    n_col = 6, 
    n_groups = 3
  )
  group_a_order <- prepare_func_output[[1]]
  group_b_order <- prepare_func_output[[2]]
  group_c_order <- prepare_func_output[[3]]
  n_row <- prepare_func_output[[4]]
  n_col <- prepare_func_output[[5]]
  
  # Group A
  plane_mat_pre_a <- matrix(0, nrow = n_row, ncol = n_col, byrow = TRUE)
  time_pre_a <- 0
  
  # # Sanity check
  # print("Before A")
  # print(plane_mat_pre_a)
  # print(time_pre_a)
  
  board_group_a_results <- board_group(
    group_order_df = group_a_order, 
    plane_mat = plane_mat_pre_a, 
    time = time_pre_a, 
    n_row = n_row)
  
  # Group B
  plane_mat_pre_b <- board_group_a_results[[1]]
  time_pre_b <- board_group_a_results[[2]]
  
  # # Sanity check
  # print("Before B")
  # print(plane_mat_pre_b)
  # print(time_pre_b)
  
  board_group_b_results <- board_group(
    group_order_df = group_b_order, 
    plane_mat = plane_mat_pre_b, 
    time = time_pre_b, 
    n_row = n_row
  )
  
  # Group C
  plane_mat_pre_c <- board_group_b_results[[1]]
  time_pre_c <- board_group_b_results[[2]]
  
  # # Sanity check
  # print("Before C")
  # print(plane_mat_pre_c)
  # print(time_pre_c)
  
  board_group_c_results <- board_group(
    group_order_df = group_c_order, 
    plane_mat = plane_mat_pre_c, 
    time = time_pre_c, 
    n_row = n_row
  )
  
  # Final
  plane_mat_final <- board_group_c_results[[1]]
  time_final <- board_group_c_results[[2]]
  
  # # Sanity check
  # print("Final")
  # print(plane_mat_final)
  # print(time_final)
  
  # # Sanity check
  # print("Target")
  # print(target_mat)
  # print(paste0("Did it work?: ", all(plane_mat_final == target_mat)))
  
  return(time_final)
}

```

### Actually running the simulation!

```{r}
results_vec <- pbreplicate(n = 1000, expr = {run_one_sim()})   # Same as `replicate()` but with a progress bar and estimated time remaining
results <- mean(results_vec)
print(paste0("The average boarding time is ", round(results, 0), " time units."))

```
